Subject: Need help with a land dispute case

Hello, my name is Karthik Nambiar. I am a 28-year-old restaurant owner living in Mumbai. I have a land dispute with Radhika Jadhav over land worth INR 4,33,00,000/-, and relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 66097 74256 or email karthik.nambiar5@example.in.
